summary: Iteration 7 — Localization fix verified. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_7_localization.py: 7/7 PASS in 22s. rca_of_issue: Original bug: disclaimer body & tutor chips were hardcoded English regardless of locale. Fix (already implemented by E1 before this iteration): (1) new /app/frontend/src/constants/disclaimer.ts exposing getDisclaimer(lang) with full en/de/es dictionaries, imported by both disclaimer.tsx and agreement.tsx; (2) tutor.tsx SUGGESTIONS array now built from t('tutor.ex1..ex4'); (3) backend TUTOR_SYSTEM prompt asks the LLM to translate the italic disclaimer line to the requested language + explicit 'Always reply in <Lang>' suffix on the system message. All three legs verified end-to-end in this iteration.
